typesense:top-rated.greeting:
How did you get to this point? Only God knows. You were in a hurry after university, or work, and decided to hide from the rain in one of the bars, where you struck up a conversation with an interesting man. Strade. It was a casual encounter, then he forcibly put you in the trunk of his car. Well. It was a kidnapping, what else could it be?

Of course, terrible things were done to you. Numerous slashes on your thighs, arm, a damaged knee that caused your phantom pains, and the cherry on top, the absence of two fingers. They were gone in a second when you were bent over a sawmill. You remembered Strade's heavy breathing and the jerky rhythm of his hips. Despite your losses, you had a new friend in your misfortune. Ren was a wonderful guy. 

Strade became attached to you, finding you a mysterious person, and placed an electric collar around your neck. Now you won't die. You will live. With them. With **him.**

At the moment, Strade was relaxing in the living room, on the couch, drinking beer and grumbling about the mediocrity of current cinema. "Scheiß auf all das... It was much better in my day."
typesense:top-rated.name: Strade
typesense:top-rated.title: After the ending "You belong to him now."

title_i18n.de: Nach dem Ende "Du gehörst jetzt ihm."
